senses.gloss: (II)--a son of तामस Manu. भा. VIII. I. २७; Br. II. ३६. ४९. Vi. III. 1. १९. [page२-206+ २८]
(III)--a son of सुधृति and father of Kevala (Candra वि। प्।). भा. IX. 2. २९. ३०; Br. III. 8. ३५; ६१. 9; Vi. IV. 1. ४०-1; वा. ८६. १३-14.
(IV)--a son of Manyu and father of सङ्कृति. भा. IX. २१. 1.
(V)--a son of Gaya and father of विरात्. Br. II. १४. ६८; Vi. II. 1. ३८; वा. ३३. ५८.
(VI)--one of the ten horses of the moon's chariot. Br. II. २३. ३५; M. १२६. ५२.
(VII)--a साध्य; is satya in the स्वारोचिष epoch. Br. III. 3. १६-7; M. २०३. ११; २५१; २४-5; वा. ६६. १५; Br. II. ३६. ५०.
(VIII)--a son of Bhuvamanyu. M. ४९. ३६; वा. ९९. १५९.
(IX)--the riding vehicle of नैऋति and drawer of Kubera's chariot. M. २६१. १५ and २२.
(X)--a son of तामस Manu. वा. ६२. ४३.
--the daughter of सुयग्ञ (श्वफल्क, वा। प्।) and wife of भन्गकार; had two sons शत्रुघ्न and Ban- धुमान्, whom अक्रूर killed. Br. III. ७१. ८७. वा. ९६. ८६.
--a son of अनृत; another name of Raurava. Br. II. 9. ६४; वा. १०. ३९.

--a nephew of हिरण्यकशिपु and son of the Earth and Vipracitti; lived in प्राग्ज्योतिष;
1: M. 6. २७; १६१. ७८; १६३. ८१-2; २४५. १२. Vi. I. २१. १२८; V. 1. २४; १२. २१.
took away a [page२-207+ ४१] number of women belonging to sages and kings to his palace, robbed Mandara of its crest jewel, Aditi of her ear- rings and वरुण of his umbrella; demanded the ऐरावत from Indra; at Indra's request was cut in twain by कृष्ण in his own city प्राग्ज्योतिष;
2: Ib. V. २९. 8-२१.
spoils distributed among his fol- lowers while all women were appropriated to कृष्ण's harem.
3: Ib. V. ३१. १४-15.
Friend of वानर Dvivida who was killed by Baladeva.
4: Ib. V. ३६. 2-२१.
--is bhaumam (earth). M. ३९. 4, 7-8; ४१. 6.

--२७ hells under Yama; to them go the un- righteous according to their respective sins; after a certain period they are born as low beings according to their कर्म।
1: Br. IV. 2. १४६-150.
Seven under the earth below the शेषलोक-- Raurava, शीतस्तप, कालसूतु, अप्रतिष्ठ, अवीची, लोहपृष्ठ, and Avidhya.
2: वा. १०१. १४४-92; Vi. II. 6. 1. (whole).

--(Naraka, s.v. Bhauma); Born of Hari in his Boar manifestation when he touched and raised the Earth,
1: भा. X. ५९. ३०[1]; [६५ (v) 1].
hence son of Earth,
2: Ib. X. ५९. ५९. [1] and 2.
an asura friend of Kamsa;
3: Ib. X. 2. 2; ३६. ३६.
a friend of the वानर Dvivida;
4: Ib. X. ६७. 2; ६९. [3] 1.
ran away with the umbrella of वरुण, कुण्डल of Aditi and contested the position of Indra.
5: Ib. X. ५९. [1] and 2.
Fought with सनैश्चर in the देवासुर war;
6: Ib. X. ७३. २०; ८३. ४०; Br. III. 6. १५; ७३. १०२; IV. २९. १२५.
find- [page२-208+ ३३] ing Mura and his sons dead, came out with elephants, which were all killed by गरुड; fought with कृष्ण till his head was cut off and the ladies of his harem married by Him (कृष्ण);
7: भा. VIII. १०. ३३.
lost his kingdom through pride of power.
8: Ib. X. ५९. १४-22; ३७. १६; I. १०. २९.
--one of the 6 kinds of fortresses. M. २१७. 6.
--the eighteenth, out of the अवतार्स् of विष्णु; did heroic deeds, subduing the sea and so on. भा. I. 3. २२.
--a वानर chief. Br. III. 7. २४३.
--one of the births of the जयादेवस्; these are विपश्चित्, Indra, Satya and Hari. वा. ५४. ७५; ६६. १४.
--the belly of the personified Veda. वा. १०४. ८४. [page२-209+ २९]
--an attribute of Kubera. M. १७४. १८.

--The अवतार् of Hari to kill हिरण्यकशिपु by the nails neither wet nor dry;
1: Br. III. 5. २६-27; ५७. ५७; ७३. ७४; वा. ६७. ६६; ९७. ७३; ९८. ७३; १११. ७२; Vi. I. २०. ३२.
on ब्रह्मा granting the request of हिरण्यकशिपु, Narasimha was approached by the gods; Narasimha promised to slay him and left for the सभा of हिरण्यकशिपु; प्रह्लाद alone knew Him to be the Lord; all the Asuras attacked him from all sides; finally Narasimha killed him by tearing him with his teeth.
2: M. ५३. ५०. chh. १६१, १६२ and १६३; २८५. 6.

(I)--(also Narasimha and नृसिम्ह) the fourteenth among the अवतार्स् of विष्णु; the first among the twelve अवतार्स्; vanquished the Asura king with the help of ओङ्कार bearing him like a mat-maker tearing the reeds. भा. I. 3. १८; Br. I. 1. १२८; III. ७२, ७३ and ७६; M. २२. १७; ४७. ४२, ४६; १६१. ३७; वा. I. १५१; Vi. IV. १४. ४७; १५. 4.
(II)--the image of; with eight hands, with the Asura below vomitting blood. M. २५९. 2; २६०. ३१.
(III)--the १६थ् kalpa. M. २९०. 7.

--a son of कालनेमि;
1: Br. III. 5. ३९; वा 67. ८०.
was killed in the लन्का war.
2: भा. IX. १०. १८.

(I)--a son of Vaivasvata Manu and father of Citrasena and Suca; his line ends with जातूकर्ण्य. भा. VIII. १३. 2; IX. 1. १२; 2. १९, २२; Br. III. ६०. 3; M. ११. ४१; १२. २०; वा. ६४. २९; ८५. 4; Vi. III. 1. ३३; IV. 1. 7.
(II)--(नाभाग) a son of स्वायम्भुव Manu. Br. II. ३८. ३१. वा. ८५ 4. [page२-210+ ४३]
(III)--a son of Marutta and father of Dama. Br. III. 8. ३५; ६१. 7; वा. ८६. १२; Vi. IV. 1. ३४-5.
--is Candragupta Maurya. Br. III. ७४. १४३.

(I)--a महानदि of the भारतवर्ष; a R. from the ऋक्ष or ऋष्यवत् hills: (Vindhyan ranges) on its northern bank was भृगुकच्छ: a sacred river that sur- vived the अन्तरक्षय, sacred to पितृस् and for श्राद्ध; in the neighbourhood of the Haihaya kingdom.
1: भा. V. १९. १८; VIII. १८. २१; Br. II. १२. १४; १६. २९; III. १०. ९७; M. 2. १३-15; २२. २५; ११४. २३; वा. ४५. ९९; ७७. ३२; ९४. २८; १०८. ८२; V. II. 3. ११.
The scene of battle between वृत्र and Indra; here Rukmi challenged कृष्ण when the latter was crossing the stream with रुक्मिणी; its current was stopped by कार्त- वीर्य.
2: भा. VI. १०. १६; X. ५४. २३[1]; Br. III. १३. 8, ३२; २६. १० and ३८; ३८. 3 and 7; ४१. १५; ४५. 2; ६९. २८; M. ४३. ३१; ४४. ३१; ४४. ३१; १६३. ६३; Vi. IV. ११. १९.
The महात्म्य of; just like मार्कण्डेय this river does not get lost in the time of the deluge; in Kalinga, near the अमरकण्टक hill; has a number of तीर्थस् like जलेश्वर, रुद्रकोटि, अम्रकण्टक, Kapila and विशल्य Karan2i. The devotee bathing in any तीर्थ on the नर्मदा gets the benefit of performing an अश्वमेध sacrifice.
3: M. ch. १८६.
The Lord enshrined here is महेश्वर who devised plans to vanquish बाणासुर of Tripura with the help of नारद. The Lord was much concerned about virtuous ladies in Tripura and नारद undertook to delude them by proclaiming ordinances to ladies to give gifts to poor and deserving Brahmanas.
4: Ib. ch. १८७.
शिव got ready for war here and attacked Tripura with incendiary materials. Out of the three cities comprising Tripura, (s.v.) two fell down reduced to ashes. The first city became converted into the श्रि S4aila hill, and the second अमरकण्टक hill, both adorned by the Siddhas, Gandharvas and so on. The Lord enshrined at the latter is ज्वालेश्वर. The third city was left unconsumed.
5: Ib. ch. १८८.
[page२-211+ ३८] It is said that at the confluence of the नर्मदा with कावेरी, Kubera practised tapas in honour of शिव and be- came the Lord of the यक्षस्. A bath here is equal to that at the confluence of the गन्गा and the यमुना.
6: Ib. ch. १८९.
To the north of the नर्मदा are a number of तीर्थम्स् like मन्त्रेश्वर, गर्जना, अम्रातक, करन्या, कुण्डेश्- vara and others. A bath in each of them rids one of all sins. Then follows other तीर्थस्, all equally sacred, includ- ing रावणेश्वर, the shrines of Kubera, अहल्यातीर्थ, and the shrine of जनार्दन. Here Agni, धर्मराज and वायु practised asceticism and attained emancipation. A visit to शुक्लतीर्थम् sacred to राजऋषि Ca1n2akya washes off all the sins of a life time. Any gift given here bears rich fruits.
7: Ib. chh. १९०-192.
Among the other sacred places can be mentioned the भृगुतीर्थम्, Kankhala, where गरुड once was in austereties, कन्यातीर्थ, पितामहतीर्थ, and स्वर्गद्वार- तीर्थम्; He who reads or listens to the glory of the नमदा has his wishes fulfilled whatever be his caste.
8: Ib. chh. १९३-194.
On its banks Purukutsa heard the विष्णु पुराण from the sages.
9: Vi. I. 2. 9; IV. 3. 7-१६.
Penance here by Asuras, who became converted into Arhats.
१०: Ib. III. १८. 1 and १३.
मरुभूमीविषय on the N. ruled by शूद्रस् and other castes.
११: Ib. IV. २४. ६८.

(II)--the मानसकन्या of शुकाला Pitr2s; given in marriage to Purukutsa by her brother Uraga; and mother of Trasadasyu; she took him to रसातल where he killed some bad Gandharvas to the satisfaction of the नागस्:
1: भा. IX. 7. 2-3; Br. III. १०. ९७; वा. ७३. ४८; ८८. ७४.
Heard the विष्णु पुराण from him and narrated it to धृतराष्ट्र the नाग and आपूरण.
2: Vi. VI. 8. ४५.
[page२-212+ २७]
(III)--the wife of युवनाश्व, son of Amba- रीष. Br. III. ६३. ७३.
(IV)--a mind-born daughter of Somapa पितृस्: one of the १६ wives of हव्यवाहन: turned into a river of दक्षिणापथ. M. १५. २५, २८; ५१. १३; वा. ७७. ३२.
--sages of, visited द्वारका. भा. X. ९०. २८. [5].
--on the नर्मदा. M. १९४. 2.
(II)--a Mauneya Gandharva presiding over the month of माधव. भा. XII. ११. ३४; Br. III. 7. 4; वा. ३०. ८६; ६९. 3; Vi. II. १०. 5.
(III)--a mountain on the base of Meru. भा. V. १६. २६; Br. II. १८. ७७.
(IV)--a Mt. in प्लक्षद्वीप; a citadel in itself; Here were born नारद and Parvata. Br. II. १९. 9; वा. ४९. 8; Vi. II. 4. 7. [page२-230+ २६]
(V)--a Mt. that entered the sea for fear of Indra; of शाकद्वीप. M. १२१. ७४; १२२. ११; वा. ४७. ७४.
(VI)--an author on architecture. M. २५२. 2.

(VII)--a son of कश्यप;
1: वा. ६१. ८५; ८६. ४८; ९४. १९; १०५. 2; १०८. 1 and ४१; ११०. 1 and ६१. १११. २३, ३८ and ५७; ११२. २७.
gave his sister Arun- धती to वसिष्ठ and was cursed by दक्ष.
2: Ib. ७०. ७९.
(VIII)--a son of प्रजापति. वा. ६९. ६४.
--a Gandharva on the वादित्रक hill. वा. १०८. ४८.
--one among the महापुराणस् com- prising २५००० s4lokas. भा. XII. 7. २३; १३. 5.

--the पुराण of २५,000 (२३००० वा। प्।) श्लोकस्; narrated by नारद and treats of the बृहद्कल्प; he who makes a gift of it on the पञ्चदशि of the अश्विनि month, has no rebirth. M. ५३. २३-4; वा. १०४. 8; Vi. III. 6. २१.
--a तीर्थम् on the नर्मदा. M. १९१. 5, २३. [page२-231+ ४७]
(I)--a तीर्थम् sacred to the पितृस्. M. २२. ४३.
(II)--the उपपुराण of १८,000 verses be- longing to the पाद्मम्. M. ५३. ६०.
--a mind-born mother. M. १९७. ११.
(II)--the name of the last son of अजामिल. भा. VI. 1. २४.

(III)--the son of भूमिमित्र Kan2va; ruled for १२ years:
1: भा. XII. 1. २०; Br. III. ७४. १५८; M. २७२. ३४; वा. ९९. ३४५.
Father of सुशर्मन्.
2: Vi. IV. २४. ४०-1.
(IV)--the sage who taught the भागवत पुराण to नारद who in turn taught it to व्यास. भा. XII. 4. ४१; १३. १० and १८.
(V)--a साध्य and overlord of the साध्यस्; the Hari of the स्वारोचिष epoch. Br. III. 3. १७; 8. 6; M. २०३. ११.
--sought by those who seek मोक्ष. भा. I. 2. २६.
--a sacred lake situated at the place where the Sindhu joins the sea; हर्यश्वस् and शबलाश्वस् performed tapas at this place. भा. VI. 5. 3 and २५.
--a Pravara. M. १९६. ३१.

--a name of योगमाया; ललिता;
1: भा. X. 2. १२; Br. IV. १३. 3.
the goddess enshrined at सुपार्श्व.
2: M. १३. ३६.
--a daughter of Meru and queen of Kuru. भा. V. 2. २३.
